public_definitions: Goal: Review the weekend pop-up Units Sold by Product dashboard, then complete the Product A merchandising review intake by selecting the appropriate product route.
Policy: < 1,000 units -> Critical sales escalation level
Policy: >= 1,000 and < 2,000 units -> Low-sales review queue activation level
Policy: < 500 units from a decision threshold -> Manual merchandising verification variance band
Policy: >= 6,000 and < 9,000 units -> Expanded replenishment planning level
Policy: >= 9,000 units -> Growth allocation review level
